items.title: Strata 0.2.19 adds Inkling 2 Mini and a 40% speedup for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
items.summary: The Strata local inference app now supports Inkling 2 Mini, with the author reporting 11,306 tok/s prefill and 4,087 tok/s output on an RTX 5090, and a claimed 40% faster Qwen3.8-Flash-Next across supported hardware. Useful for people running these models on consumer GPUs.

doubt.pushback: Numbers are the author's own on a single 5090 setup; one replier saw little gain on an IQ3S quant (prefill only).

reception.summary: Repliers mostly asked about multi-GPU and PCIe monitoring issues; at least one tried it and saw only a small prefill gain on a 3-bit quant.

items.title: TensorFold fork cuts DGX Spark image time from 80.6s to 12.7s, level with a Mac Studio M5 Ultra
items.summary: On the author's TensorFold fork, the same 2048 picture now takes 12.7s on a DGX Spark, down from 80.6s, against 12.6s on a Mac Studio M5 Ultra. The changes are not merged upstream yet.

doubt.pushback: Author's own timing on a fork that is not upstream; not independently reproduced.

items.title: Google DeepMind engineer compares four agent harnesses across about 350 tasks: similar scores, cost per task $2.33 vs $4.68
items.summary: A conference talk summary reports that four agent harnesses scored similarly over roughly 350 tasks, while a Bash plus media tool setup cost $2.33 per task versus $4.68 for one with eight file tools. Argues eval scores should include cost.

doubt.pushback: Post carries no link to the talk or data; numbers cannot be checked from the post.
